facts.fact: On 3 August 2026 the Assemblée législative du peuple voted the personal data protection bill, and the Justice Minister said the law prohibits transferring sensitive data abroad; the article does not report promulgation, so the rule is recorded as adopted by the legislature but not yet reported in force.
